hints.title: Inverted Index for Characters
hints.text: Preprocess character positions in the target string to speed up subsequence matching.

hints.title: Sorted Position Lookups
hints.text: Store indices for each character in sorted order, finding next occurrences via index searches.

hints.title: Binary Search Index Advancement
hints.text: For each character in a word, advance the current index to the smallest position strictly greater than the previous index using bisect.

complexity.notes: Inverted index with binary search per character and word-level memoization.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning string s independently for each word requires O(W * S) operations, which times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Positions list stores S indices total across 26 character buckets.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use inverted index with bisect_right or bucket waiting queues to match all words concurrently.
